charts.name: Jamaica reference chart of accounts
charts.legal_reference: This pack found no legal chart of accounts in Jamaica, and opened neither the Companies Act nor the Income Tax Act: no section of either is cited. What the General Consumption Tax Act asks of a registered taxpayer is a tax invoice and records, as Tax Administration Jamaica's GCT page describes. This chart is original: four digits, blocked so that each range reaches one line of a statement of financial position and an income statement presented in the manner of IFRS for SMEs, which is a choice of this pack and not a text the country imposes. The settlement account of the GCT return (2100, refundable 1172) is distinct from the accounts the tax posts to (2101 and 2102 collected, 1170 and 1171 recoverable). See README.md

numbering.legal_reference: Tax Administration Jamaica, GCT page: a tax invoice is pre-numbered, carries the words 'Tax Invoice' and is issued within seven days of the supply, one per supply. The page does not say the series may have no gap, which is why `numbering` is `sequential` and not `gapless`; `number_format` is a convention this pack proposes. The Act itself was not opened

payment_terms.legal_reference: No Jamaican text read for this pack sets a payment term between two businesses or a rate of interest on a commercial debt paid late: the penalties and interest on a late return are charges on the taxpayer towards the Commissioner, not a term between two businesses. `legal_payment_days` and `late_payment_reference` are empty

tax_point.legal_reference: The time of supply rule of the General Consumption Tax Act was not opened for this pack. `earliest_of_delivery_or_payment` is the nearest value of the closed vocabulary and is the tax point the pack proposes; the user confirms it with their accountant

einvoicing.legal_reference: No Jamaican text read for this pack obliges a business to issue or accept an electronic invoice: Tax Administration Jamaica's GCT page asks for a pre-numbered tax invoice without naming a platform, a format or a Peppol profile. No Peppol authority for Jamaica was looked for. `profile`, `party_scheme` and `vat_scheme` are null: there is no domestic profile to name

not_taxed.legal_reference: Not modelled, and not a finding that the service is untaxed. Form 4A has a line for imported services (line 20, the full amount paid treated as the deemed supply, and line 21 the tax; line 35 the credit that qualifies) and the instructions treat the amount as a supply taxed at the applicable rate. The pack carries no code for this self-assessment (the tax would be both collected and credited by the recipient): such a purchase is entered with JM-P-EX and the user, with their accountant, accounts for the tax outside the pack. See README.md
